eyebrow: Base image choice, side by side
code:
$ docker images
REPOSITORY   TAG          SIZE
node         20           1.1GB
node         20-slim      230MB
node         20-alpine    140MB
caption: slim strips most of the Debian userland; alpine goes further on musl-based Alpine Linux.

eyebrow: .dockerignore keeps junk out of the build context
caption: Without it, COPY . . sends your local node_modules and .git history to the daemon too.

eyebrow: Clean up in the same layer it was created in
code:
# One layer -- cache never outlives the layer that created it
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
caption: Deleting the apt cache in a LATER RUN doesn't shrink anything -- it's already baked into an earlier layer.

eyebrow: docker history -- find what's taking up space
code:
$ docker history northbridge/catalog:1.4
IMAGE         CREATED BY                       SIZE
a3f8e9c1b2d4  CMD ["node" "server.js"]          0B
<missing>     RUN npm install --production      98MB
caption: Layer by layer, in size order -- exactly where to look when an image is bigger than expected.
